name: comet-trail-worker
description: Evergreen crawl collector: a Cloudflare Worker that intercepts bot traffic, extracts SEO data, and stores it in D1.

scripts.db:recent: wrangler d1 execute comet-trail --remote --command "SELECT url, status, response_time_ms, title, bot_name, datetime(ts/1000,'unixepoch') AS seen FROM crawls ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20"
